name: metro-station-designer
description: Root tooling for the Station Designer concept-art site. The site itself lives in web/ and is deployed to Cloudflare Workers as static assets.

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:game && npm run setup:model
scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build:game: npm --prefix game ci && npm --prefix game run build
scripts.deploy:game: npm run build:game && wrangler deploy -c game/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build:stats: node --check stats/worker.js && node --check stats/page.js && node --check stats/favicon.js && node --check stats/brand-mark.js
scripts.deploy:stats:ci: npm run build:stats && wrangler deploy --config stats/wrangler.jsonc --env=
scripts.version:stats: npm run build:stats && wrangler versions upload --config stats/wrangler.jsonc --env=
scripts.check:roads: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/check-road-placement.mjs
scripts.check:demos: npm run build && npm run build:game && node tools/check-demos.mjs
scripts.check:info-panel: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/check-info-panel.mjs
scripts.check:tutorial: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/check-game-tutorial.mjs
scripts.check:render-batching: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/check-render-batching.mjs
scripts.profile:browser: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-demos.mjs browser --profile --gpu-timer --investigate
scripts.bench:browser: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-demos.mjs browser
scripts.bench:usage-tour: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-usage-tour.mjs
scripts.bench:road: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-road-drag.mjs
scripts.bench:stair: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-stair-drag.mjs
scripts.bench:block-drag: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-block-drag.mjs
scripts.bench:levels: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-level-switch.mjs
scripts.check:geometry-detail: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/check-geometry-detail.mjs
scripts.check:passenger-lod: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/check-passenger-lod.mjs
